tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and the editor's side panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs; always with a shadow token.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control tracks, wells, empty states, code.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, ghost buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Toasts and tooltips: the opposite of the current theme.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Behind the video player and thumbnails in both themes, so videos read the same everywhere.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders and dividers (decorative, no contrast floor).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons: at least 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy that should step back slightly, on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, helper text and labels, on any surface (5.8:1 light, 7:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholders of disabled fields only; exempt from contrast.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected segment, progress fill, the logo disc.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of brand buttons (lighter, so on-brand contrast rises).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on a brand fill. Never white: white on teal fails contrast.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Links and teal text on bg, surface and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active scene, Generating badge background.

tokens.name: brand-soft-line
tokens.usage: Border of a selected row or card on brand-soft.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: solid 2px ring, 2px offset in bg. 3:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The spoken-word highlight in captions and one emphasised word in a headline. Brand moments only, never status.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on a highlight fill.

tokens.name: highlight-soft
tokens.usage: Rare tinted ground for a brand moment (onboarding tip, empty state art).

tokens.name: highlight-text
tokens.usage: Coral text on bg, surface or highlight-soft.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons: Ready, Published. On surface or success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ready / Published badge background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention text: Scheduled, Edited, Expiring soon. On surface or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Scheduled / Edited badge background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons: Failed, Missed, validation errors. On surface or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Failed badge and error banner background.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill (Delete, Disconnect).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on danger-fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and tips, text and icons. On surface or info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info banner background.

spacing.note: A 4 px base. Use these steps for padding, gaps and layout; nothing in between.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (sm), list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; card padding on mobile; button padding (md).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (default); gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections inside the app.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between marketing blocks on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Marketing hero top and bottom padding on desktop.

radius.note: Soft but not round. Pills only for badges, chips and the segmented-control track.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Scene thumbnails in lists, tiny tags, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segments inside a segmented control, menu items, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, video thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the editor's player frame, marketing feature tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, avatars, progress bars.

shadow.note: Borders separate; shadows only lift things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Hovered cards and draggable scene rows.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets, with the scrim behind.

layout.note: Fixed sizes of the app frame and breakpoints.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max width of marketing content and the library grid.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of scripts, chat and long text.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: App navigation sidebar on desktop.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: App and marketing top bar.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Below this, the sidebar collapses to a bottom bar and grids go to one or two columns.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: From this width the editor shows scenes, player and chat side by side.

zIndex.note: Stacking order; nothing else uses z-index.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar, sticky table headers.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets (and their scrim).

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
